semantics.PASS: Reproduced in automated synthetic tests or inspected deterministic rule; does NOT certify real-world image accuracy.
semantics.FAIL: Known unmet requirement or recorded incorrect output.
semantics.REVIEW: Partial evidence, unresolved readiness, or human review required.
semantics.NOT TESTED: No admissible independent empirical test for this scenario.
